items.summary_zh: 数百栋房屋和公共建筑严重受损，至少 53 人死亡。

items.title: Hurricane Lala sparks flash floods in Hawaii as strong winds and rain persist
items.summary: Officials say flash flooding may have swept away homes with people in them in worst-hit areas.

items.summary_zh: 官员们表示，在受灾最严重的地区，山洪可能已经冲毁了有人居住的房屋。

items.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
items.summary: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

items.summary_zh: 周日凌晨，旅游巴士翻车，造成数十人重伤。

items.title: Europe's tallest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in rural Poland
items.summary: The 55.6-metre (182ft) concrete figure is head-and-shoulders above Rio de Jaineiro's Christ the Redeemer.
items.title_zh: 欧洲最高的圣母玛利亚雕像在波兰乡村揭幕

items.title: Belgian wildfire doubles in size on third day tearing through nature reserve
items.summary: Hundreds of firefighters are trying to contain the flames consuming the major park.

items.summary_zh: 数百名消防员正在努力控制吞噬主要公园的火势。

items.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum

items.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
items.summary: Security had been stepped up amid suggestions on social media of a second mass crossing on Saturday.

items.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
items.summary: The declaration was made on the national day of the central European country, which has a population of just 44,000.

items.summary_zh: 该声明是在这个人口仅有 44,000 的中欧国家的国庆日发表的。

items.title: Trump’s Other Hold on the Americas: The Visa
items.summary: As part of its expansionist approach to the Western Hemisphere, the Trump administration is trying to reassert its dominance, one U.S. visa at a time.
items.title_zh: 特朗普对美洲的另一大手笔：签证
items.summary_zh: 作为其西半球扩张政策的一部分，特朗普政府正试图重申其主导地位，一次一张美国签证。

items.title: Art Heist: 4 Antonello da Messina Paintings Stolen From Sicily

items.summary_zh: 这些作品由安东内罗·达·梅西纳创作，拍摄于西西里岛墨西拿市举行宗教庆典时。

items.title: After Women in India Joined Protests, Online Harassment Followed
items.summary: Widespread online abuse and visits from the police show the added risks women take standing up for their beliefs in a patriarchal society.

items.summary_zh: 广泛的网络虐待和警察的访问表明，女性在父权社会中捍卫自己的信仰所面临的额外风险。

items.title: A Shooting at the U.S. Consulate in Toronto Exposes a Neighborhood’s Guns-for-Hire Network

items.title: With Priests Scarce in Rural Italy, an African Pastor Is Filling the Void
items.summary: Immigrants have long eased labor shortages on farms and factories in Italy. But churches also need foreign-born priests, like the Rev. Vincent Souly of the Ivory Coast.
items.title_zh: 意大利农村牧师稀缺，一位非洲牧师正在填补这一空白

items.title: The Iranian YouTube Show Posing Questions Few Dare Ask

items.title: Crypto investors are looking past market-cap rankings and back to fundamentals

items.summary_zh: 行业高管表示，投资者开始根据使用情况、经济性和价值捕获来判断加密代币，而不是市值排名。
